output.title: A slow payment provider
output.description: At three seconds the payment provider slows tenfold. Compare no timeout, a 600 ms timeout, forty connections with threads freed, and the same pool holding threads. Every run includes order-status requests; timeouts do not cancel provider work.

simulations.title: No timeouts
simulations.description: Checkout fills all 100 threads after the slowdown. Its queue keeps growing; the gateway eventually returns 504s after waiting five seconds.

expectations.label: Orders DB order-status work falls behind

simulations.title: A 600 ms timeout
simulations.description: Payments time out, then their late replies are discarded. Checkout releases each thread after 600 ms and the gateway never times out: degradation instead of a stall.

expectations.label: Orders DB keeps serving order status

simulations.title: Threads freed while waiting for the pool
simulations.description: Payment calls wait off-thread for one of forty connections. Order status only calls Orders DB and keeps completing during the slowdown. Payments queued longer than the gateway’s five-second timeout fail there; provider work continues.

simulations.title: Threads held while waiting for the pool
simulations.description: The same pool holds waiting threads as well as connections. Order-status work queues behind them. Payments queued longer than the gateway’s five-second timeout fail there; provider work continues.
